## Critical Rule Mathematical Definitions
- Daily Loss Limit (Balance-Based): Loss Floor = Day-Start Balance - (Initial Balance * Daily Loss %). Open profits do not move the floor upward.
- Daily Loss Limit (Equity-Based): Loss Floor = Day-Start Equity - (Initial Balance * Daily Loss %). High floating intraday profits ratchet the floor up.
- Static Max Drawdown: Breach Floor = Initial Balance - (Initial Balance * Max Loss %). Permanent fixed level.
- Intraday Trailing Drawdown: Breach Floor = Highest Unrealized Peak Equity Reached - Max Loss Allowance.
- 1% Floating Loss Rule: Any single position reaching -1.00% unrealized loss relative to starting account nominal capital triggers an instantaneous termination.

## Direct Answers to Common Prop Firm Rule Questions

### What is the consistency rule in a prop firm?
A consistency rule restricts the maximum percentage of total profit that can be earned in a single trading day (typically 20% to 50%) before a trader can pass an evaluation or request a payout: `Required Total Profit = Best Single-Day Profit / Max Consistency %`. If your best day exceeds the cap, the account is not breached, but your profit target increases until that single day represents less than the allowed percentage.
- Canonical Rule Guide: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/rules/consistency-rule
- Prop Firms with No Consistency Rule: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/with-no-consistency-rule

### Which prop firms have no hidden rules and static drawdown?
Prop firms offering verified static maximum drawdown (where the loss floor remains permanently fixed below initial starting balance and never trails unrealized profit) combined with transparent balance-based daily loss calculation include FTMO, The 5%ers (High Stakes), Funding Pips (2-Step), E8 Markets (2-Step), and Goat Funded Trader (2-Step Standard).
- Prop Firms with Static Drawdown: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/with-static-drawdown
- Static Max Drawdown Math Guide: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/rules/max-drawdown-static
- Hidden Conditions & Conflict Detection Guide: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/rules/hidden-conditions

### What is the max lot size rule at prop firms?
The maximum lot size rule (or contract scaling limit) caps the total standard lots or futures contracts a trader can hold open simultaneously or execute per single order, alongside the 80% margin utilization gambling cap (`Used Margin / Current Equity <= 80%`). Exceeding hard contract caps in futures or triggering margin-gambling thresholds in CFD accounts can result in trade liquidation, profit deduction, or hard breach.
- Lot Size & Contract Limits Guide: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/rules/lot-size-limits
- 80% Margin Gambling Rule Guide: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/rules/gambling-margin-80
- Leverage & Margin Calls Guide: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/rules/leverage-margin

### How do 5K 2-Step prop firm account rules work?
On a $5,000 2-Step prop firm evaluation account, traders must typically achieve an 8%–10% Phase 1 profit target ($400–$500) and a 5% Phase 2 target ($250) without breaching a 4%–5% daily loss limit ($200–$250) or an 8%–10% static maximum drawdown ($400–$500, fixed floor at $4,500–$4,600). Because nominal dollar buffers are small on $5K accounts, traders must watch out for spread widening at rollover and micro-loss tripwires.
- Micro Account Risk Tripwire Guide: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/rules/micro-risk-tripwire
- Profit Targets by Phase Guide: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/rules/profit-targets-phases
- Alpha Capital $5,000 Alpha Pro 8% 2-Step Rules: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/alpha-capital/accounts/acg-pro810-5k
- Moneta Funded $5,000 2-Step Rules: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/moneta-funded/accounts/moneta-2step-5k
